summary.key_theme: 受惠於美國國債殖利率下降與機構投資者持續增持，比特幣價格強勢突破 7 萬美元，帶動 IBIT 資金流入與市場看漲情緒。

bullish.title: Bitcoin Reclaims $70K: Why Falling Treasury Yields Could Supercharge Spot BTC ETFs
bullish.reason: 比特幣突破 7 萬美元大關，國債殖利率下降提升了風險資產吸引力，直接利好 IBIT 等現貨比特幣 ETF 的資金流入。

bullish.title: Bitcoin Surges Above $71,000 as Raoul Pal Says It's The 'Bessent Put' and 'The Signal Is Enormous'
bullish.reason: 比特幣價格進一步攀升至 7.1 萬美元，且單週 ETF 流入量突破 10 億美元，顯示機構資金強勁回流。

bullish.title: Paul Tudor Jones Is Buying Bitcoin ETF IBIT Again — But His Trade Has Changed
bullish.reason: 知名對沖基金經理 Paul Tudor Jones 增持 IBIT 18.9 %，顯示專業投資人對比特幣長期配置的信心。

bullish.title: QUICK SPARK: Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Load Up on Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs
bullish.reason: 摩根士丹利與摩根大通在第二季大幅增加比特幣 ETF 持倉，強化了市場對主流金融機構採用比特幣的預期。

bullish.title: Jane Street’s Bitcoin ETF Exposure Hits $1B, Goes 5X Bigger On XRP In Q2
bullish.reason: Jane Street 披露持有近 10 億美元的比特幣 ETF 部位，顯示大型做市商與機構對 IBIT 的流動性支持。

bearish.title: IBIT’s 0.25% Fee Sells Off Bitcoin Daily, and the Prospectus Calls Every Sale a Taxable Event
bearish.reason: 指出 IBIT 的管理費機制涉及每日賣出比特幣，可能產生稅務影響，對長期持有者構成潛在成本考量。

bearish.title: Will Bitcoin Drop Below $60K as BTC ETFs See Biggest Outflow in 6 Weeks?
bearish.reason: 報導曾提及 ETF 出現資金流出，反映市場對短期價格波動與支撐力道的擔憂。

neutral.title: Harvard Did Not Sell Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings in Q2, Discloses No New Ethereum ETF Stake
neutral.reason: 哈佛大學維持其比特幣 ETF 持倉不變，屬於中性持倉訊號，無顯著買賣動作。

neutral.title: Amazon, Target And More On CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
neutral.reason: 專家將 IBIT 列為頂級交易標的之一，屬於市場觀點分享，對股價影響有限。
